Services

Built around manufacturer growth and dealer execution.

HomeCare Provider Services helps bridge the gap between manufacturers and dealers by supporting the activities that drive real market adoption.

Consulting is advisory and strategy. If you'd rather HCPS handle the execution for you — marketing, website, and online presence — see our done-for-you Dealer Services.

Dealer Network Development

Identify, qualify, onboard, and support dealers aligned with manufacturer goals, product categories, and territory strategy.

Showroom & Floorplan Design

Help providers optimize showroom layout with our build in generator in our Golden Technologies ordering platform, category flow, product visibility, traffic patterns, and customer experience.

Product Launch Strategy

Support new product introductions with dealer education, literature, in-services, launch messaging, and follow-up activity.

Territory Expansion

Help manufacturers evaluate and develop new territories through dealer relationships, market insight, and focused outreach.

Sales Training & Education

Provide product presentations, dealer-facing education, showroom selling points, and in-service support for sales teams.

Dealer Resource Planning

Organize dealer tools including literature, pricing access, product videos, order forms, service links, and support workflows.

Product Mix Strategy

Help dealers evaluate category gaps, complementary products, showroom priorities, and opportunities to improve revenue.

Trade Show & Event Support

Support manufacturer presence, product demonstrations, dealer events, regional trainings, and customer education opportunities.

Process

Simple, practical, field-focused.

1

Assess

Review the manufacturer line, dealer goals, territory, showroom, product mix, and current market activity.

2

Plan

Create a focused strategy for dealer engagement, product positioning, showroom support, training, and market development.

3

Execute

Support outreach, presentations, literature, in-services, dealer onboarding, and product launch activity.

4

Optimize

Refine the approach based on dealer feedback, sales activity, manufacturer priorities, and market response.
